claims.text: Experiments are conducted on the IWSLT14 German-to-English and WMT14 English-to-German tasks.
The experiments investigate the necessity of the learning rate warm-up stage and its sensitivity to the value of T_warmup.
Different learning rates are tested for both Adam and SGD optimizers during the experiments.
The experiments are repeated ten times using different random seeds to ensure consistency.
